projects.title: LLM-Based Clinical Referral Triage Automation
projects.description: An end-to-end triage pipeline that classifies emergency-department encounters into three ESI acuity levels from MIMIC-IV-ED clinical notes and vitals, behind an 11-step preprocessing stage (vitals parsing, outlier handling, clinical-threshold flagging). Benchmarked 4 open-weight LLMs (dense & MoE, 24–35B, quantized to fit L4 VRAM) across 6 prompting strategies — zero/few-shot, chain-of-thought, role-based and structured output — served locally via vLLM with concurrent inference over ~7,000 predictions. Best result (Gemma-3 + few-shot) reached 73% accuracy with zero parse errors, and a safety-focused evaluation of under-triage drove a 5–12pp reduction via calibration prompting and curated, class-balanced few-shot exemplars.

projects.title: ADAS Traffic-Sign Spoof Verification
projects.description: A modular, multi-sensor framework that flags spoofed and contextually implausible traffic signs in ADAS perception, fusing contextual, physical (camera–LiDAR) and pixel-level branches through a reliability-aware late-fusion layer. Built the contextual branch (104 association-rule-mining rules + calibrated logistic regression on BDD100K) and released a public, human-verified BDD100K annotation extension of 16,515 VLM-labeled sign crops on IEEE DataPort.
